user.title: BTicino Thermostat
user.description: How would you like to set up your BTicino thermostat(s)?

menu_options.cloud: Set up automatically from BTicino cloud (recommended, especially with multiple thermostats)
menu_options.manual: Enter IP address and PIN manually

manual.title: BTicino Thermostat
manual.description: Enter the IP address of your thermostat and the local PIN (XOpen password).

data.retrieve_from_cloud: Don't know the PIN? Retrieve it from Cloud

manual_cloud.title: Retrieve PIN from Cloud
manual_cloud.description: Enter your BTicino cloud credentials to retrieve the local password.

manual_select_plant.title: Select Thermostat
manual_select_plant.description: Multiple thermostats were found (either across different plants or multiple gateways in the same plant). Select the one whose PIN matches the IP address you entered.

cloud.title: Connect to BTicino Cloud
cloud.description: Enter your BTicino cloud account credentials. We'll look up every thermostat registered to your account and set them all up.

cloud_gateway.title: Thermostat {index} of {total}
cloud_gateway.description: "{gateway_label}". Enter its local IP address to add it now, or leave this field blank to skip it — you can add it later from Settings > Devices & Services.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the thermostat. Check the IP address and make sure it is reachable.
error.no_password_found: No local password found in cloud data.
error.host_required: IP address is required to retrieve the PIN from cloud.
error.pin_required: PIN is required. Check the checkbox below to retrieve it from the cloud.

abort.no_devices_added: No thermostats were added — every gateway was either skipped or failed to connect.
